title: UAAP: Pasilang, Espanol lead FEU past UE to strengthen hold on third seed
summary: Far Eastern University turned back University of the East, 81-63, to maintain its hold on third place in the UAAP Season 89 women’s basketball on Wednesday at the Araneta Coliseum in Cubao.
